title: Rohan Buluswar
text:
Hello! I am an first-year PhD student in the Statistics and Data Science department at UPenn Wharton.
I am broadly excited about both mathematical and scientific foundations of deep learning. My current interests include mechanistic interpretability, AI safety, and diffusion models.
Before beginning my PhD, I completed my BS in Mathematics at the University of Chicago, where I was fortunate to work with Prof. Lorenzo Orecchia on sampling algorithms utilizing optimal transport, and the use of evolution semigroups in studying properties of diffusion models.
Outside of research, I enjoy playing board games (my current favorite is Blood on the Clocktower), attending the symphony orchestra, and SCUBA diving.
If we share any common interests, please feel free to get in touch!
